visualCharacteristics: 16:9 Vimeo player in the right half of a split section
contentPattern: One row, one cell: optional poster image above a Vimeo or YouTube link (e.g. https://vimeo.com/935746990/72b444d313). Unlisted Vimeo links keep their privacy hash.
usage: A single video player, usually beside introductory text in a split section and followed by an accordion-transcript block.
reuseGuidance: Use for Vimeo or YouTube videos. Put the transcript in an accordion-transcript block directly after it.
